scenes.title: Left Cingulum Frontal Parahippocampal · source probability
scenes.prompt: Follow Left Cingulum Frontal Parahippocampal through all three MRI planes. Rotate the complete source field surface and compare its visible companions.
scenes.note: Original source file: Cingulum_Frontal_Parahippocampal_L.nii.gz. The probability overlay uses the original fraction values. The 3D surface and binary overlay use the inclusive 0.20 display threshold; overlapping memberships remain independent. The matching MRI consists of an exact original template subarray, with its voxel positions retained.
